81811.title: The Annex Chapel in the parish of Saint Anna came to decay after the parish had acquired a new church in 1821. During Carl-Lennart Fogelberg’s energetic management, the building was restored by the early 1960s. In 1973, the chapel was reopened by Bishop Ragnar Askmark.
